name: ompo
description: OMP Roadmap Orchestrator — long-horizon sequential workflow driver for stock omp (no core fork). Implements OMP_ROADMAP_ORCHESTRATOR_PLAN.md §§5–6, 11–14 out-of-core via `omp -p` workers.

scripts.web:build: bunx vite build --config web/vite.config.ts && bun scripts/embed-web.ts
scripts.build: bun run web:build && bun build --compile src/cli.ts --outfile ompo
